title: Transport of a null carrier-support symmetric difference into graph coordinates
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, M and S subsets of R^(n+l), xi in R^(n+l), R and s reals with s <= R, Q a linear isometry equivalence of R^(n+l), u : R^n -> R^l any function, G(x) := graphPoint x (u x), Gamma := graphOver u (Bo^n_R(0)) (H^n := muHE[n]). Assume Q((S - xi)) cap Bo_R(0) = Gamma cap Bo_R(0) and H^n((M cap Bo_s(xi)) symmetric-difference (S cap Bo_s(xi))) = 0. Then for every rho with 0 < rho <= s, H^n((Q((M - xi)) cap Bo_rho(0)) symmetric-difference graphOver u W_rho) = 0, where W_rho := {x in Bo^n_rho(0) : ||graphPoint x (u x)|| < rho}.
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (M S : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (ξ : Amb n ℓ) (R s : ℝ) (Q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), s ≤ R → Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' S) ∩ ball 0 R = graphOver u (ball 0 R) ∩ ball 0 R → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (M ∩ ball ξ s) (S ∩ ball ξ s)) = 0 → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ρ ≤ s → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (Q '' ((fun x => x - ξ) '' M) ∩ ball 0 ρ) (graphOver u {x | x ∈ ball (0 : Rn n) ρ ∧ ‖graphPoint x (u x)‖ < ρ})) = 0
